scope: Decision support requested by the user. No new experiment or GPU job is authorized by this discussion.

illustration.assumptions: Independent rollouts on one question with binary rewards and fixed per-rollout positive probability p.

decision_options: Keep the two-question check as software qualification only.
Propose a representative eligible-question feasibility screen with calibrated per-question reward distributions and token costs.
If broader evidence shows little usable variation, compare a stronger starting model or supervised warm-start using training-only references.
recommendation: Measure representative reward coverage before selecting a corpus RL setup. Finding one qualifying question is insufficient evidence of corpus-level learning efficiency.
